name: Discovery (STS-26R)
about: Discovery (STS-26R) (1988-091A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1988 Sep 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1988 Oct  1), held fixed
GCAT names the site (EAFB RW17); its coordinates are written from memory
